Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: HIV infection confirmed by ELISA, HIV culture, or p24 antigenemia
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient's medical history does not mention HIV infection or any related testing.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Suspected subclinical Pneumocystis carinii infection as detected by > 10 percent change in lung volumes and/or diffusing capacity
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information provided about pulmonary function tests (PFTs) or Pneumocystis carinii infection status.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Afebrile and no respiratory signs or symptoms of clinical disease
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient's description does not mention fever or respiratory symptoms.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Morphologic confirmation of pneumocysts via bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) within 2 weeks of PFT abnormality
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No PFT abnormalities or BAL results are documented in the patient's history.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Diagnostic bronchoscopy and BAL within 2 weeks of PFT abnormality
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No PFT abnormalities or bronchoscopy/BAL details are provided.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Ability and willingness to sign informed consent
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Primary prophylaxis with agents active against Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia (PCP), but no more than 5 patients may have received prior prophylaxis with aerosolized pentamidine
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No prior prophylaxis with pentamidine is mentioned.
No mention of Zidovudine use, so compliance is assumed.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No history of PCP is documented.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Development of respiratory signs and/or symptoms between PFT abnormality and initial aerosol deposition
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No PFT abnormalities or respiratory symptoms are mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Dyspnea, cough, or bronchospasm preventing cooperation with aerosol administration
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of respiratory symptoms or inability to cooperate.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: History of major adverse reaction to pentamidine
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No history of pentamidine-related adverse reactions is documented.
Patient is not on Zidovudine, so compliance is assumed.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Unable to cooperate with aerosol administration
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of inability to cooperate.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Another antiprotozoal regimen for this episode
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No other antiprotozoal regimen is mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Unable to complete therapy or follow-up for social reasons
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of social reasons preventing therapy/follow-up.
